title: Election night news monitor MVP
description:
Build every feature specified in `SPEC.md` phases 0 through 4: feed collection, the DuckLake store, the parser pipeline, the full dashboard with drill-downs and citations, and the operating tools. Code freeze is Tue Nov 3, 3:00 pm ET. Stretch items in spec §19 are outside this epic and are parked in a separate deferred ticket.

## Delivery

All children land in one PR from one branch cut from `main`. Open it as a draft once the scaffold and CI exist so checks run on every push. Close each child on the branch as it finishes, so closures ride in the PR. Commit per coherent chunk of work. Daniel merges.

## Order

Children carry a `phase-N` label and block on the acceptance ticket of the phase before them, following spec §0.2. Baseline collection starts as soon as the poller works, and it keeps running from the branch while later work proceeds.

Hardening starts no later than Tue 12:00 ET whether or not the depth work is finished, so it depends only on the dashboard core. If depth work is behind at that point, stop it and report what is unfinished. Cut order if time runs short, first to last: tour mode, Global Press panel, search, entity page, Who band.

## Decisions that differ from the spec text

Tested on Nov 1 with DuckDB 2.0.0 and fastembed 0.9.1 unless marked otherwise.

- **Configuration:** tunables live in `.env`, read through `pydantic-settings` and `python-dotenv`, with nested keys such as `LLM__DAILY_USD_CAP=40`. `.env.example` is committed and lists every Appendix A setting. There is no `config/settings.toml`. Structured data stays in `config/*.csv` and `config/*.yaml`. (Owner preference.)
- **Vectors:** DuckLake rejects `FLOAT[384]` with "unsupported type". `nlp.embeddings.vec` and `nlp.storylines.centroid` are `FLOAT[]`, cast to `FLOAT[384]` at query time, which works.
- **Embedding model:** fastembed does not list `intfloat/multilingual-e5-small`. See the embedding ticket for the resolution.
- **Dependencies:** DuckDB's Python client requires `pytz` for `TIMESTAMPTZ` values, so it is a direct dependency.
- **Gold tables:** spec §0.5 says append-only and §9.5 says rollups rebuild recent bins. Rollups compare against the latest stored values and append only rows that changed, including zero rows for keys that vanished. Readers take the latest row per key.
- **Latency:** items move between stages through in-process queues and do not wait for a lake commit. A 30-second commit between each of five stages could not meet the 90-second target. Lake state is used for restart and backfill.
- **LLM schemas:** `ItemB.places` and `ItemB.races` are typed models, not `list[dict]`, because structured outputs need closed schemas. `ItemA` gains `is_opinion` to support the default answer to open question Q5.
- **Feed target:** the Phase 0 gate uses the §19 figure of 250 healthy feeds. The §5.2 figure of 250 healthy outlets is reported, not gated, because only 273 outlets are seeded.
- **Ticket titles:** phase numbers appear only as labels.

## Open questions

Spec §21 defaults apply unless Daniel answers otherwise.

title: Scaffold repository with dotenv settings, logging, and CLI skeleton
description:
Spec: §0, §4, §6, §15, §16, Appendix A.

**Do:**
- Run `git init -b main`. Make the first commit on `main` with `SPEC.md`, `sources_seed.csv`, `.gitignore`, and the committed `.beads/` files. Cut the MVP branch from it.
- Write `CLAUDE.md`: spec §0 verbatim, then the contents of `agent-approach-brief.md` with its project placeholders filled in. Keep the brief on disk and git-ignored.
- Create the §6 tree at this repo root with `uv` on Python 3.12: package `monitor`, console script `monitor`. Add §4 dependencies plus `python-dotenv`, `pytz`, `xxhash`, `zstandard`, and `typer`.
- Write `settings.py` with `pydantic-settings`: `.env` file, `__` nested delimiter, every Appendix A value, plus `load_dotenv()` so libraries that read the environment see the API keys. Commit `.env.example` listing every setting with its default, plus `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=` and `FEC_API_KEY=`. Paths are settings, so tests can point at a scratch lake.
- Configure structlog JSON lines in `logs/`, rotating at 50 MB × 5.
- Register every §15 command in the Typer app. Write the `Procfile` (pipeline, web, css).
- Point `HF_HOME` and `FASTEMBED_CACHE_PATH` at `data/models/`.
- Configure pytest: `--basetemp=tmp/pytest` so tests never write to system temp, `slow` and `llm` markers excluded by default, `pytest-socket` blocking network by default.
- Run the §16 disk check and report it. Free space on Nov 1 was 36 GiB.

**Accept:** `uv run monitor --help` lists every §15 command. `uv run pytest` passes. `.env`, `data/`, `logs/`, and `tmp/` are git-ignored.

title: Build the parser framework, stage orchestrator, and language detection
description:
Spec: §7 stage state, §10 interface, parser P1.

**Do:**
- `parsers/base.py` with the §10 protocol.
- Orchestrator: items flow through in-process queues per stage, so a stage does not wait for a lake commit. `input_query` runs at startup and for backfill. Results go to `BatchWriter`.
- `nlp.parser_runs` tracking, retries with backoff (max 3), and rate-limited reprocessing when `parser_version` changes.
- `monitor pipeline --no-llm --stages a,b,…`. Queue depths and stage lag exposed for `/status`.
- `lang` parser: compare install size of `lingua-language-detector` and fasttext lid.176 and use the smaller. Trust the feed's declared language when consistent.

**Accept:** a killed pipeline resumes without reprocessing finished items. A failing fake parser retries, then records `error`. `nlp.lang` covers the baseline.

title: Build the Claude client with schemas, cost ledger, and budget guard
description:
Spec: §0.8, §12, §15 `monitor cost`.

Read the `claude-api` skill's Python files before writing this code.

**Request settings, from the skill on Nov 1 (confirm with the V7 smoke test):**
- Haiku 5.5 at $0.10/$0.50 per MTok; Sonnet 5.5 at $2/$10. Both match the spec.
- Haiku 5.5 runs adaptive thinking and `medium` effort by default. Set `output_config.effort` explicitly. `thinking: {type: "disabled"}` is accepted at effort `high` or below, so Stage A sends `low` effort with thinking disabled.
- Sonnet 5.5 returns 400 for `thinking: {type: "disabled"}`. Briefs use adaptive thinking at `medium` effort.
- Do not send `temperature`, `top_p`, `top_k`, or assistant prefill.
- Structured output through `messages.parse` with Pydantic models. All schemas are closed.
- Minimum cacheable prefix is 512 tokens. Requests sent before the first response starts cannot read the cache, so after startup or a 5-minute idle gap, send one request and wait for it to start responding before opening concurrency.
- Haiku has no server-side refusal fallback: treat `stop_reason: "refusal"` as an item error. Sonnet brief calls send `fallbacks: "default"` with beta `server-side-fallback-2026-07-01`.

**Do:**
- `llm/client.py`: semaphores A=6, B=8, misc=2; retries on 429, 5xx, and connection errors; one retry on validation failure; handling for `refusal` and `max_tokens`.
- `llm/schemas.py` per §12, with `ItemB.places` and `ItemB.races` as typed models and `ItemA.is_opinion` added.
- `nlp.llm_calls` ledger with `usd_est`. Model IDs and prices come from settings.
- `llm/budget.py`: at 80% of `LLM__DAILY_USD_CAP`, low-signal international sources use keywords; at `LLM__HARD_USD_CAP`, only briefs run. Days roll over at midnight ET. State is exposed for the status strip.
- `monitor cost`.

**Accept:** unit tests with a fake transport cover refusal, `max_tokens`, validation retry, and each budget transition. A live two-call test shows `cache_read_input_tokens` > 0.

title: Classify and translate every item with Haiku and keyword fallback
description:
Spec: parser P2, §5.5, §10.2, §11.1, §12 prompt rules, §18.

**Do:**
- `config/taxonomy.yaml` and multilingual `config/election_keywords.yaml`.
- `classify_a` parser: batches of 10, source scope and home state as context, translation of non-English headline and summary, `is_opinion` from URL and section heuristics plus the model. System prompt holds taxonomy, instructions, few-shots, and the condensed watchlist in a byte-stable prefix.
- Keyword path with `method='keywords'`, used by `--no-llm`, the budget guard, and outage degradation.
- `tests/fixtures/golden.jsonl`: 30 hand-labeled articles across levels and languages. Contract tests marked `llm`.

**Accept:** relevance accuracy ≥ 90% and `primary_level` agreement ≥ 80% on the golden set. Every item in a test run gets a `classify_a` row through one path or the other.

title: Embed items and deduplicate syndicated copies
description:
Spec: parsers P3 and P4, §3, §9.3, Appendix B V6.

**Embedding model:** fastembed 0.9.1 does not list `intfloat/multilingual-e5-small`, but the Hugging Face repository has `onnx/model.onnx`. Register it with `TextEmbedding.add_custom_model` and check it returns normalized 384-dim vectors. If it fails to load or cannot keep up on the M4 CPU, use fastembed's `sentence-transformers/paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2` (384-dim, 0.22 GB), remove the `passage:` and `query:` prefixes, and retune the similarity thresholds, which were written for e5. Neither path installs torch. Record the outcome as V6.

**Do:**
- `embed` parser: batch 32, 30–50% duty cycle, one embedding per item, batch rate reduced on a pipeline lag signal.
- `dedupe` parser: within 36 h, normalized-title SimHash distance ≤ 3, or cosine ≥ 0.95 with the same `published_at` day. Writes `nlp.dup_groups` with one canonical member per group.

**Accept:** unit tests for canonicalization and SimHash pass. A syndicated fixture collapses into one group. Embedding keeps up with baseline volume within the duty cycle.

title: Cluster storylines online with Haiku naming
description:
Spec: parser P9, §10.1, §14.5 validator.

**Do:**
- Online clustering of relevant canonical items against centroids of `candidate` and `active` storylines with an item in the last 8 h. Join at τ_join, EMA update with α = 0.1, re-normalize.
- Promotion at ≥ 3 unique items from ≥ 2 sources within 3 h. Merge pass every 10 min at cosine ≥ 0.88. Dormancy after 4 h, with revival on join. All changes append new rows.
- Haiku naming on promotion and at 50% growth: 8 most central headlines plus c-TF-IDF keywords in; neutral label ≤ 8 words and footnoted summary ≤ 2 sentences out.
- `llm/citations.py`: trims sentences without a citation, drops citations to ids that were not supplied, logs counts. Briefs reuse it.
- Tune τ_join on the baseline. Write similarity histograms to `reports/` and the chosen value to `.env.example` and `docs/VERIFY_LOG.md`.

**Accept:** spot-check of 20 storylines on the baseline reported with coherent and incoherent counts. Validator unit tests pass.

title: Build geography, state, and poll-closing reference data
description:
Spec: §9.4, §11.4, §11.5, Appendix B V12.

**Do:**
- `scripts/build_ref_data.py` and `monitor ref build-geo`: Census Gazetteer files into `ref.states`, `ref.counties`, `ref.places` and `data/ref/`.
- `us-atlas` `states-albers-10m.json` and `counties-albers-10m.json` into `web/static/topo/`.
- `config/poll_closings.yaml`: first-close and all-close times checked against a current published table. Record the table's URL for V12.

**Accept:** every state and DC has FIPS and closing times. `data/ref` is under 150 MB. `ref.states` carries `poll_close_et` and `poll_close_all_et`.

title: Build the race watchlist, candidate roster, and entity aliases
description:
Spec: §9.4, §11.2, §11.3, Appendix B V10, V11, V14.

**Do:**
- `monitor ref build-candidates`: OpenFEC 2026 House and Senate candidates (confirm endpoint and filters for V10; `DEMO_KEY` may be too low for full pagination). Governors and statewide offices through the Wikipedia API. Hand list in `config/entities_extra.yaml`.
- `monitor ref build-races [--dry-run]`: ratings with source and URL into `config/races.yaml` and `ref.races`; `close_race` per §11.3. Battleground states derived from close Senate and governor races plus an override list. Must be re-runnable Tuesday morning.
- `monitor ref build-aliases`: one Haiku call per 100 entities for short names and nicknames, plus Arabic, Chinese, Russian, Spanish, and French renderings for the top 100.
- `monitor ref all`. Race-key normalization with unit tests.

The ticket closes when the data is built. Daniel's confirmation of the battleground list (V14) happens at the run-of-show review.

**Accept:** `ref.entities` and `ref.races` populated. Report lists battleground states, close races, and differences from the §11.3 starting list.

title: Propose cited lean ratings and mirror sources to the lake
description:
Spec: §5.3, §5.4, §9.4, Appendix B V13.

**Do:**
- For each enabled US outlet, web-search its AllSides rating page, and Ad Fontes values where publicly available, one outlet at a time with no bulk scraping. Write `config/lean_ratings.csv` with rating, URL, retrieval date, and a `confirmed` column.
- List every disagreement with the seed's `lean_hint`.
- Display rule: rows Daniel has not confirmed show `Unrated`. Outlets with no rating show `Unrated`. International outlets show `NA` and "Non-US outlet".
- Fill `ownership` and `reliability_note` in `config/sources.csv` where a cited source states them.
- Mirror to `ref.sources`, appending new rows on file change.

A research subagent may gather the ratings, using `./tmp/` for scratch. Check its citations before they enter the CSV. The ticket closes when proposals are delivered; Daniel's confirmation (V13) can happen any time before freeze.

**Accept:** every enabled US outlet has a rating with URL and date, or is explicitly `Unrated`. `ref.sources` matches the CSVs.

title: Compute gold rollups and trend metrics
description:
Spec: parser P11, §9.5, §13, §18.

**Do:**
- `rollups.py`: 5-minute bins for `gold.bin_counts`, `storyline_bins`, `state_bins`, `source_bins`, `topic_bins`, `lean_storyline_bins`, with unique and all-copies values. Entity and county tables follow with extraction.
- Every 30–60 s, recompute the last 2 h of bins, compare with the latest stored values, and append only changed rows, including zero rows for vanished keys. Full rebuild nightly and through `monitor rollups --rebuild`.
- `analytics.py` as pure functions: velocity score, rising, new, state attention index, tone aggregates with shrinkage and CI, coverage by lean, first to report. Attention baseline window: Nov 1 12:00 to Nov 3 12:00 ET.
- `as_of` filtering in every query.

**Accept:** §18 unit tests for velocity, attention, and tone pass. A rollup cycle on the baseline finishes in under 30 s. Rebuild and incremental values agree. Queries at an earlier `as_of` exclude later bins.

title: Backfill baseline items and confirm enrichment acceptance
description:
Spec: §19 enrichment criteria.

Backfill every baseline item through language, classification, embedding, dedupe, and storylines, then check and report:
- Median first-seen to classified ≤ 60 s on live items.
- Storyline spot-check of 20 looks coherent.
- `cache_read_input_tokens` > 0 in the ledger.
- Golden-set contract tests pass. Budget guard and ledger working.
- Spend to date against the §12 estimate of $15–35 for Nov 1–4.

title: Add check script, process-label lint, PR template, CI, and GitHub repository
description:
Spec: `agent-approach-brief.md` §3, §6, §9, §13.

**Do:**
- Write `scripts/check.sh`: `ruff format --check`, `ruff check` at line length 79, `mypy src` (non-strict, missing imports ignored), `pytest`, `scripts/lint_process_labels.py`.
- Copy the lint from `~/Documents/projects/otzar/scripts/lint_process_labels.py` and adapt its exclusions, adding `web/static/vendor`.
- Write `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md` following `~/Documents/projects/stele/.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md`. Omit the changelog item: this project has no releases and spec §6 lists no changelog.
- Write `.github/workflows/ci.yml` with SHA-pinned actions following stele's `ci.yml`. It runs `scripts/check.sh` with no API keys.
- Create the GitHub repository with the visibility Daniel chose, push `main`, push the branch, open a draft PR.
- Require the `check` status on `main`. GitHub only offers branch protection on private repositories with a paid plan; if the API refuses, report that and continue.

**Accept:** CI is green on the draft PR.

title: Vendor frontend assets and build design tokens
description:
Spec: §0.10, §4, §14.1, Appendix B V8, V9.

**Do:**
- `scripts/vendor_assets.sh` pins exact versions and downloads htmx 2, the htmx SSE extension, Vega 5, Vega-Lite 5, vega-embed, D3 7, topojson-client, and Inter into `web/static/vendor/`. Commit the results.
- Download the Tailwind v4 standalone binary, git-ignored, with a checksum. Commit compiled CSS so the app runs without the binary. `css` Procfile entry runs watch mode.
- Confirm Altair's generated Vega-Lite major version matches the vendored one, and pin whichever pair agrees.
- Design tokens per §14.1: party colors, PuOr tone scale, sequential volume scale, monochrome lean glyph, type scale. Light, dark, and projector themes.

**Accept:** a test page with charts renders with the network off. Versions recorded for V8 and V9.

title: Build the web shell with read-only queries, SSE, and global controls
description:
Spec: §0.4, §7, §14.1, §14.2, §14.7, §15.

**Do:**
- FastAPI app with read-only lake attach and `monitor web [--host] [--port] [--lan]`.
- Poll `lake.snapshots()` every 3 s, with `data/last_commit.json` as the fallback signal. SSE `/events` emits `snapshot`, `wire`, `brief`, `status`.
- Named parameterized SQL in `web/queries/`. Result cache keyed by `(snapshot_id, query_name, params)`, LRU 512.
- Sticky header: title, ET clock, LIVE/REPLAY pill, KPI tiles, next poll closing, all right-side controls. Status strip with disk banners.
- Global controls in query params. Focus semantics per §14.2, with `ui.sqlite` holding watchlist and override.
- 12-column grid with fixed-height panels.

**Accept:** p95 fragment < 150 ms on baseline data. Header and status strip update without reload. A copied URL reproduces the view.

title: Build the Now band: Live Wire, Rising Storylines, and Briefing
description:
Spec: §14.3 Band 1, §14.7.

- **Live Wire (4 cols):** rows per spec, prepends through SSE with `sse-swap="wire"`, pauses on hover, fades in new rows.
- **Rising Storylines (5 cols):** cards by velocity with server-rendered SVG sparkline, velocity badge, outlet count, 5-segment monochrome lean bar, state chips, NEW tag, one-line summary.
- **Briefing (3 cols):** latest brief with prev/next, timestamp, and covered window. Shows an empty state until briefs exist.

**Accept:** new items appear without layout shift. Storyline cards rank by the §13 velocity score. Every panel respects all global controls.

title: Build the Where band: state map and Race Calls table
description:
Spec: §14.3 Band 2, §14.7.

- **US Map (7 cols):** D3 choropleth from pre-projected TopoJSON with keyed joins and fill-only transitions. Metric toggle: attention (default), volume, mean tone. Battlegrounds outlined, non-focus states dimmed, tooltip per spec, click to state page, inset of top 8 rising states.
- **Race Calls (5 cols):** columns per spec, rows expand to citations, banner "Claims as reported by news outlets; not official results." Empty until extraction lands. Respects Focus.

**Accept:** map updates without redraw. Tone metric hides below n = 5. The banner is always visible.

title: Build the What band: Storyline Stream and Topic Heat
description:
Spec: §14.1, §14.3 Band 3, §14.7.

**Do:**
- Altair spec builders. `/api/spec/<chart>` (cached) and `/api/data/<chart>`. On `snapshot`, JS refetches data and calls `view.data('table', rows).run()`, with no re-embed.
- **Storyline Stream (8 cols):** centered stacked area, top 10 plus Other, toggle to normalized 100%. Labeled poll-closing rules. Hover highlights across panels. Click to storyline page.
- **Topic Heat (4 cols):** topics × 15-min bins over 3 h.
- Shared time domain and crosshair over a small JS event bus.

**Accept:** charts keep hover state through a data update, with no flicker. Crosshair moves together across time charts.

title: Add replay, projector mode, keyboard shortcuts, breakpoints, and screenshots
description:
Spec: §14.6 except tour, §14.7 REPLAY, §18 visual check.

**Do:**
- Replay: client-driven `as_of`, speeds 1×, 5×, 20×, time scrubber, SSE ignored during replay.
- Projector mode: `p` key or toggle, 1.25× type, thicker strokes, high-contrast light default, hidden status strip and secondary controls, chart labels ≥ 16 px.
- Keyboard: `1`–`5`, `f`, `w`, `/`, `Esc`, `←`/`→`, `r`, `p`.
- Breakpoints: ≥ 2200, 1600–2199, 1280–1599 px.
- `scripts/screenshots.py`: Playwright at 1280×720, 1920×1080, 2560×1600 in light, dark, and projector modes, saved to `reports/screens/`.

**Accept:** replay of a past hour shows no data after `as_of`. All three sizes render without horizontal page scroll.

title: Capture screenshots and confirm dashboard core acceptance
description:
Spec: §19 dashboard core criteria.

**Check and report:**
- Live updates with no flicker.
- p95 fragment < 150 ms, measured on baseline data.
- Screenshots of `/` at three sizes in `reports/screens/`, for Daniel's review.

Depth work and hardening both depend on this ticket.

title: Fetch full article text for relevant items
description:
Spec: parser P5, §9.1, §9.3 step 1, §17.3.

`fetch_text` parser for items with `relevance_conf ≥ 0.5`: trafilatura, 1 request per 3 s per domain, robots.txt honored, 10 s timeout, text ≤ 20k chars. Skips `paywall=hard` sources and records `paywalled`. Prefers `<link rel=canonical>` when present. The disk guard disables it below 5 GB.

**Accept:** robots-disallowed and hard-paywall URLs are not fetched. A fixture article extracts cleanly. `raw.article_text` grows without blocking other stages.

title: Extract entities, tone, places, and race calls with Haiku
description:
Spec: parser P6, §9.2, §12 prompt rules and schemas, §18.

**Do:**
- `extract_b` parser: 1 item per call, concurrency 8, text truncated at a paragraph boundary to ≤ 6k tokens, summary used when no text exists.
- Writes `nlp.extract_b`, `nlp.mentions` with char offsets from string search, `nlp.places` with `method='llm'`, `nlp.race_calls`.
- Tone evidence must appear verbatim in the text and be ≤ 25 words; otherwise that mention's tone is null.
- Race calls require explicit language per §12. Normalize `called_by` to the §9.2 set.
- Add Stage B cases to the contract tests.

**Accept:** schema valid across the golden set. A fixture saying a candidate "leads" produces `status=leading`, never `projected`. Evidence quotes pass the verbatim check.

title: Resolve mentions to entities and places to FIPS, and extend rollups
description:
Spec: parsers P7, P8, P10, §9.5, §18.

**Do:**
- `entities`: exact, normalized, then rapidfuzz ≥ 92 within the same state or race context. Resolved copies append to `nlp.mentions`. Every 5 min, send the top 30 unresolved PERSON surfaces to Haiku for resolution or new-entity proposals.
- `geo`: gazetteer match; ambiguity resolved by state in the item, then source home state, then population. Accept `cd_code` when formatted `XX-NN`.
- Map race-call claims to `race_key`.
- `tone_local`: tone stays null when the API is down, and tone panels show "paused".
- Rollups: `gold.entity_bins`, `entity_lean_bins`, `county_bins`, and tone in `state_bins`.

**Accept:** §18 unit tests for gazetteer disambiguation and race-key normalization pass. A sample of top mentions is resolved, with the unresolved share reported.

title: Implement monitor verify and record results in the verification log
description:
Spec: §0.3, §19, Appendix B.

`monitor verify` runs checks V1–V7 and writes the Appendix B table to `docs/VERIFY_LOG.md`. Later tickets fill in V8–V14 as they do that work.

**Record these results from the Nov 1 probes, then re-confirm them through the command:**
- DuckDB 2.0.0, ducklake extension `417a9117f5`, sqlite_scanner `e223dc0149`, DuckLake format 1.1.
- Read-only attach works and rejects INSERT: `ATTACH 'ducklake:sqlite:<catalog>' AS lake (DATA_PATH '<dir>', READ_ONLY)`.
- `CALL lake.set_option` accepts `parquet_compression`, `parquet_compression_level`, `target_file_size`, `data_inlining_row_limit`. `lake.options()` and `lake.snapshots()` exist.
- `ducklake_flush_inlined_data`, `ducklake_merge_adjacent_files`, and `ducklake_cleanup_old_files` run. `ducklake_expire_snapshots` failed in the probe only because `pytz` was absent; confirm it with `pytz` installed.
- `FLOAT[384]` is rejected in DuckLake; `FLOAT[]` works and casts to `FLOAT[384]` for cosine similarity.

**V7 needs `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` in `.env`.** It is not set in the environment and the `ant` CLI is not installed. Without a key, V7 reports failure and collection continues.

**Accept:** with a key set, `monitor verify` exits 0. Any failing check is named in the output and in the log.

title: Generate cited briefs with Sonnet
description:
Spec: parser P12, §12, §14.3 Briefing, §14.5, §21 Q6.

**Do:**
- `briefs` parser: `claude-sonnet-5-5` at `medium` effort. Input is gold rollups, top storylines, and top items with their ids.
- Runs every 20 min from 4 pm ET Nov 3, hourly otherwise, plus 10 min after each major poll close, plus `monitor brief --now [--focus …]`.
- Runs `llm/citations.py` on output and stores `markdown` and `citations` in `nlp.briefs`. Logs trimmed-sentence and dropped-citation counts.
- Briefing panel: real data, prev/next, `brief` SSE event.

**Accept:** every stored sentence has a citation to a supplied item. A fixture with an invented id has that citation removed.

title: Build the Who and Coverage bands
description:
Spec: §13, §14.3 Bands 4 and 5, §21 Q5.

- **Entity Rank Bump (6 cols):** top 12 per 15-min bin, party-colored, labels at line end.
- **Tone by Outlet Lean (6 cols):** top 10 entities, mean with CI per bucket plus overall. Hidden below n = 5, hollow below n = 15. Opinion items excluded by default.
- **Coverage-by-Lean Matrix (7 cols):** top 12 storylines by lean bucket plus Non-US, sorted by divergence.
- **Global Press (5 cols):** non-English share by language in small multiples, plus latest 6 translated headlines with the original in a tooltip.

**Accept:** values match §13 definitions in unit tests on fixture rows. Charts update through `view.data()`.

title: Add footnotes and evidence drawers to every aggregate
description:
Spec: §14.1, §14.5.

**Do:**
- Footnote component: `[n]` superscript, hover popover with headline, outlet, lean glyph, and time, click opens the article drawer. Used in briefs and storyline summaries.
- Evidence drawer: paged items sorted by time, with the exact filter shown ("GA · 8:00–8:15 pm · unique · focus=Battlegrounds"). Wire it to map states, heat cells, bump points, matrix cells, and KPI tiles.
- Lean labels link to the `/sources` row, which links to the external rating page.

**Accept:** a Playwright walk clicks one element of every aggregate panel and sees an evidence drawer whose item count matches the number clicked.

title: Build the article page, drawer, and semantic search
description:
Spec: §14.4 `/article` and `/search`, §17.3.

**Do:**
- `/article/{item_id}` as page and drawer: original and English headline, outlet with lean citation, times, extracted text with entity and place spans, per-entity tone and evidence, classification badges, storyline, 8 nearest neighbors, syndication group, "Open original", collapsible raw parser JSON.
- `/search`: embed the query in the web process, brute-force cosine over a vector matrix refreshed on snapshot, optional keyword filter, facets for level, state, outlet, lean, and time. The model is loaded on first use and stays read-only against the lake.

**Accept:** article drawer closes with `Esc` and keeps the page state. A non-English query returns relevant English items. Search p95 is measured and reported at the baseline's item count.

title: Build the storyline, entity, and state drill-down pages
description:
Spec: §14.4 `/story`, `/entity`, `/state`.

Build every section the spec lists for each page:
- `/story/{storyline_id}`, including related storylines by centroid.
- `/entity/{entity_id}`, including tone with CI band and evidence quotes from both extremes.
- `/state/{usps}`, including county choropleth, races with watch toggle, local outlets, and poll-closing time.

All numbers open evidence drawers. All pages honor global controls and `as_of`.

**Accept:** screenshots of `/story/x` and `/state/GA` at three sizes. An unknown id returns a clean 404.

title: Build the sources, methods, status, and watchlist pages
description:
Spec: §5.3, §5.4, §14.4 `/sources`, `/methods`, `/status`, `/watchlist`.

- `/sources`: sortable table with every listed column, §5.3 criteria text, lean-distribution chart, flags for `state_affiliated` outlets and the Kommersant censorship note from the seed.
- `/methods`: renders `docs/METHODS.md`, written to cover the pipeline diagram, models and versions, abridged prompts, §13 definitions, limitations, and the cost summary.
- `/status`: feed health grid, stage lags, queue depths, LLM spend by purpose, disk breakdown, last maintenance and backup.
- `/watchlist`: edits watched races and states and the battleground override in `ui.sqlite`. No lake writes.

**Accept:** a watchlist edit changes Focus results immediately. Every lean label on `/sources` has a citation or reads `Unrated` or "Non-US outlet".

title: Add tour mode
description:
Spec: §14.6.

`t` key starts a full-screen rotation every 30 s (from settings) through Rising Storylines, Briefing, Map, Stream, Who, and Race Calls. Any interaction pauses it. A progress bar shows time to the next panel.

**Accept:** one full rotation at 1920×1080 runs with live data and pauses on a keypress.

title: Confirm depth and citation acceptance
description:
Spec: §19 depth criteria.

**Check and report:**
- Every aggregate opens its evidence.
- Every brief sentence is cited.
- Every lean label has a citation or shows `Unrated`.
- Screenshots of `/`, `/story/x`, and `/state/GA` at three sizes in light, dark, and projector modes, for Daniel's review.

If this is unfinished at Tue 12:00 ET, report what is incomplete and move to hardening.

title: Implement and drill the degradation ladder
description:
Spec: §8.4, §17.2, §19 hardening.

**Do:**
- Automatic behavior: after 2 min of LLM failures, Stage A uses keywords and Stage B queues, with "LLM degraded" in the UI. Pipeline lag > 120 s halves embed rate and pauses backfill. Slow web raises fragment throttle to 20 s.
- Drills on a scratch lake: invalid API key, then recovery; lag injected; each disk threshold triggered through the injected free-space function. Spec §19 suggests filling a disk quota; the injected function tests the same guard without filling a volume that is 92% used.

**Accept:** each rung triggers and recovers. Results written to `reports/`.

title: Load-test the pipeline and dashboard and add replay-check
description:
Spec: §15 `monitor replay-check`, §18 load test.

**Do:**
- Synthetic burst of 2,000 items in 5 min through the pipeline with `--no-llm`, on a scratch lake so baseline data stays clean. Measure pipeline lag and dashboard latency.
- `monitor replay-check --from T --to T`: counts by bin for demo preparation.

**Accept:** item visible ≤ 90 s after first seen under burst, p95 fragment < 150 ms at 100k items, or the shortfall is reported with a proposed mitigation.

title: Create the DuckLake layer and all lake tables
description:
Spec: §0.4, §0.5, §7, §8.1, §9.

**Do:**
- `lake.py`: read-write and read-only connection helpers that install and load `ducklake` and `sqlite`.
- Set options: `parquet_compression=zstd`, `parquet_compression_level=6`, `target_file_size=128MB`, `data_inlining_row_limit=2000`.
- `monitor init`: idempotent. Creates directories, schemas `raw`, `nlp`, `gold`, `ref`, and every §9 table. Timestamps are `TIMESTAMPTZ` in UTC. IDs are xxhash64 hex.
- Table changes from §9: `vec` and `centroid` are `FLOAT[]`; `raw.fetches` gains `etag` and `last_modified` so conditional GET survives restarts; `nlp.classify_a` gains `is_opinion`.
- `BatchWriter`: buffers rows per table, commits all of them in one transaction every `COMMIT__BATCH_SECONDS`, and writes `data/last_commit.json` atomically.
- A shared SQL pattern for reading the latest row per key.
- Writer lock: the pipeline holds `data/writer.lock`. CLI commands that write (`prune`, `rollups --rebuild`, `brief --now`, `ref build-*`) drop a request file in `data/control/` for the pipeline to run when the lock is held, and run directly when it is not. This keeps §0.4's single-writer rule true while the pipeline runs.

**Accept:** tests on a scratch lake show `init` runs twice cleanly, a commit becomes visible to a read-only connection, a read-only write is rejected, small commits stay inlined, and cosine similarity works over stored vectors.

title: Write the run-of-show, rehearse, and freeze
description:
Spec: §2, §17.1, §19 hardening, Appendix B V11–V14.

**Do:**
- Write `docs/RUN_OF_SHOW.md`, including power, awake-state, and restart steps for the Mac.
- Tue 12:00: `monitor ref build-races`, `monitor sources check`, review `/status`.
- 12:30: replay last 6 h at 20×. Check every panel at 1280×720 and 1920×1080.
- 2:30: clean restart, `monitor backup --now`, confirm LLM caps. Daniel plugs into the projector for the projector-mode check.
- Daniel confirms V13 (lean ratings) and V14 (battlegrounds). Confirm V11 and V12.
- Update the PR body to cover the whole diff and mark it ready for review.
- 3:00: freeze. After this, only `.env` thresholds, source enable/disable, and watchlist change.

**Accept:** rehearsal completed and CI green by 3:00 pm ET. Report the PR link, CI result, and anything unfinished.

title: Soak-test concurrent DuckLake reads during writer commits
description:
Spec: §7, §18, Appendix B V2.

`scripts/soak_lake.py` runs on a scratch lake: one process commits every 2 s, another queries every 0.5 s, for 10 minutes.

If readers error, apply these in order and re-run: SQLite WAL on the catalog plus reader retry with backoff; Postgres.app catalog (Plan B); `gold.*` exported to Parquet for the web process (Plan C). Ask Daniel before installing Postgres.app.

**Accept:** 10 minutes with zero unrecovered reader errors. Result and any change of plan recorded in `docs/VERIFY_LOG.md`.

title: Discover and validate feeds into config/sources.csv with OPML round-trip
description:
Spec: §5.1, §5.2, §5.3, §15.

**Do:**
- `monitor sources discover`, trying in order: known patterns per outlet (seed `notes` name many), `<link rel=alternate>` on the homepage and `/politics` / `/elections`, then common paths.
- Validate each candidate: HTTP 200, parses, ≥ 5 entries, newest entry < 72 h (< 7 days for `scope=local`). Keep up to 3 feeds per outlet, preferring politics and elections sections.
- Write `config/sources.csv` with every §5.1 column. Do not carry `lean_hint` into `lean_label`: US outlets start as `Unrated`, non-US as `NA`.
- Write `reports/feed_validation.md`: failures with reasons, and counts against the targets (≥ 2 per state, ≥ 4 per battleground state, ≥ 3 per non-English language).
- `monitor sources check`, `monitor sources export-opml PATH`, `monitor sources import-opml PATH`.

**Seed limits:** 273 outlets. Nine of the 17 battleground states in §11.3 are seeded below the target of 4: GA, NH, IA, AK, NE, MN, AZ, and NV have 3; KS has 1 (the Kansas City Star and KCUR cover KS but are filed under MO). The report proposes additions. Replacing or adding outlets waits for Daniel's approval.

**Accept:** report written and Daniel told the counts. `export-opml` then `import-opml` reproduces the same feed set.

title: Poll feeds by tier and write fetches and items to the lake
description:
Spec: §7, §9.1, §9.3 step 1, §17.2 item 4, §17.3, §18.

**Do:**
- Async poller with `httpx[http2]` and `feedparser`: tiers 60/180/600 s, ETag and Last-Modified, per-domain concurrency 2, 15% jitter, backoff. Circuit-break a feed after 5 consecutive failures and retry every 15 min.
- URL canonicalization. One `raw.items` row per canonical URL, with an in-memory seen set loaded on startup. Summary HTML stripped, ≤ 2000 chars.
- `monitor pipeline` writes `raw.fetches` and `raw.items` through `BatchWriter`.
- Fixtures for RSS 2.0, Atom, and malformed feeds. Unit tests for canonicalization.

**Start collecting as soon as this works.** Run detached with `caffeinate -is honcho start pipeline`, logging to `logs/`. Restart it when pipeline code changes. Collection stops if the Mac sleeps, so it needs power and an open lid.

**Accept:** items and fetches grow across two commits. After a restart, conditional GET returns 304s and no duplicate items appear.

title: Schedule lake maintenance and backups, report disk use, and implement prune
description:
Spec: §8.2, §8.3, §8.4, §15.

**Do:**
- Every 15 min in the pipeline, skipping if a commit is in flight: `ducklake_flush_inlined_data`, `ducklake_merge_adjacent_files`. No automatic snapshot expiry.
- Every 15 min: SQLite online backup to `data/backups/catalog-YYYYmmdd-HHMM.sqlite.zst`. Keep the last 12 plus one per hour. `monitor backup --now`.
- `monitor disk`: lake live data, retained by snapshots, catalog, backups, models, logs, free space.
- `monitor prune`: all forms in §8.4 plus `--dry-run`. Uses `ducklake_expire_snapshots`, then `ducklake_cleanup_old_files`, then `VACUUM` on the catalog. `--thin` picks versions from `lake.snapshots()`.
- Disk guard behind an injectable free-space function: < 10 GB yellow, < 5 GB red and no full-text fetching, < 3 GB automatic `--thin 15m --older-than 1h` with a loud log line.

**Accept:** on a scratch lake, row counts are unchanged after every prune form, dry-run figures match the real run, a restored backup is queryable, and each guard threshold fires under a faked free-space value.

title: Start baseline collection and confirm foundation acceptance
description:
Spec: §19 foundation criteria.

**Check and report:**
- ≥ 250 healthy feeds, plus outlet, per-state, and per-language counts against §5.2.
- Items accumulating. `monitor disk` works. Maintenance and backup jobs have run.
- Soak test passed. `monitor verify` results logged. CI green.
- < 200 Parquet files after 2 h.

Daniel reviews the feed failures. Enrichment work may start once the poller is running and the other checks pass; the 2-hour file count is reported when it elapses.

title: Build the stretch features listed in the spec
description:
Spec: §14.3 stretch panels, §19 stretch list. Outside the MVP epic. Split into separate tickets if any are picked up.

- Co-mention network (D3 force) and `gold.comention_edges`
- First-to-report beeswarm
- Source health table on the main page
- "Ask the data": Sonnet text-to-SQL over `gold.*`, read-only, SQL shown
- Congressional district maps on 2026 lines
- Live-blog tracking
- GDELT 15-minute supplement
- Seat-count-from-news-calls widget with disclaimer
- "Replay the night" export for class
